name: 大唐西游完整修正版
group_note: 西游记-lineage codebase (大唐西游/Journey of the East). Full WASM pass: (1) adm/daemons/convertd.lpc's Greek-table stray backslash bug (§6.6, ~45 occurrences, exactly the documented pattern) blocked simul_efun's compile; fixed with the documented CRLF-aware sed. (2) A two-files-same-purpose trap (§7.56-class): there's BOTH a /daemons/logind.lpc (dead-code duplicate, no LOGIN_D-macro reference anywhere) and the real /adm/daemons/logind.lpc that LOGIN_D actually resolves to -- initially traced the wrong one and got a completely different (and shorter) registration flow; the real file has extra steps the dead-code copy lacks (a separate 管理密码/'super password' step with stricter complexity rules, sandwiched between the Chinese name and the regular login password, plus a post-gender attribute-reroll menu). (3) The GB/BIG5 encoding menu (§8.7's 'second mechanism shape', local int-flag override + convertd.lpc byte-pair table) WAS a live bug here -- selecting BIG5 spammed 'Invalid GB code' and corrupted output, since the table assumes raw GB2312 bytes and this codebase is now UTF-8 throughout; fixed by mapping both menu choices to encode=0 (the passthrough this family's convertd.lpc already treats as safe). Admin (fluffos/Mud@2026) seeded via real registration + adm/etc/wizlist.
